test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 12 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who has been appointed as the Revenue Secretary by the Indian government in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Malhotra**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Centre has appointed Sanjay Malhotra**, a **1990 batch Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the Rajasthan cadre, as the new revenue secretary.**
 
• He will replace **Tarun Bajaj **who will superannuate at the end of November.
 
• Malhotra,** currently serving as secretary in the Department of Financial Services (DFS), will join the Revenue Department as an officer on special duty.**
 
• The centre has announced new secretaries for 16 ministries and departments.
